hash_lock.book_corpus_recipe: sha256 of the UTF-8 concatenation of `<path>\t<source_sha256>\n` for all 27 content/brain/books Markdown files in LC_ALL=C path order
hash_lock.tree_manifest_recipe: The `*_tree_sha256_at_inventory` values below use a DIFFERENT recipe from book_corpus_sha256: sha256 over `JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2) + "\n"` where rows = [{path, sha256}] for every file under the tree. Row order is Array.prototype.sort with String.prototype.localeCompare, NOT byte order. Byte order reproduces the knowledge and books digests (their paths are ASCII) but NOT the content/brain digest, whose Korean paths sort differently. This recipe was undocumented before batch 05 and is recorded here so the baselines are re-derivable.
hash_lock.batch_baseline_role: deterministic source baseline and sample-seed INPUT. It is NOT the AC-15 `sample.json` seed, which computeBatchSample() derives from { batch_id, approved_knowledge_tree_sha256, batch_manifest_sha256, proposal_manifest_sha256 }.

line_count_definition: physical lines. A terminal newline terminates the last line and does not begin another; line_count is NOT `split("\n").length`.
span_hash_recipe: sha256 over the UTF-8 text of lines [start_line, end_line] inclusive, joined with \n, heading line included, no trailing newline
prose_line_definition:
a line inside the scope, after the heading line, that is not blank, not inside a fenced code block, not a fence delimiter, and not a bare

code_line_definition: a line inside the scope, after the heading line, that is inside a fenced code block, counting the opening and closing fence delimiter lines themselves
scope_definition: an ATX heading line plus every line up to (but excluding) the next ATX heading of any level, or the last line of the file. Headings inside fenced code blocks are NOT scope starts. Content before the first heading belongs to no scope.
engine_substantive_definition: true when the engine's own substantiveBodyText() from tooling/brain/knowledge.mjs returns true for the scope's body lines with frontmatter removed - exactly the gate validatedEvidenceSpan() applies before accepting a locator. Authoritative for rejection-probe selection; prose_lines/code_lines are descriptive.
evidence_class_definition: EXCLUSIVE classes: prose-bearing (prose_lines > 3), low-evidence-prose (0 < prose_lines <= 3), code-only (prose_lines = 0 AND code_lines > 0), zero-evidence (prose_lines = 0 AND code_lines = 0). Every scope has exactly one; the four counts partition the scope total.
positive_prose_definition: INCLUSIVE tally of scopes with prose_lines > 0 = prose-bearing + low-evidence-prose. It OVERLAPS the low-evidence class, is not an evidence_class, and is never part of the partition.

rejection_probe_policy.justification: The Book corpus contains four frontmatter-only Markdown files: headfirst/chap01.md, kafka/chap03.md, kafka/chap04.md and the root landing page books/index.md. The three CHAPTER files were adopted as file-level rejection probes by book-batch-01, which APPLIED with all three recorded in rejected-candidates.json as insufficient-source-evidence with proposal_created false. Whole-document negative coverage is therefore already discharged against these exact, still-unchanged bytes, so batch 05 takes no file-level probe.

scope_level_rejection_probes.definition: heading scope whose body is non-substantive under the engine's substantiveBodyText() gate. For both batch-05 probes this coincides with prose_lines = 0 AND code_lines = 0; the engine gate is the authoritative criterion.
scope_level_rejection_probes.note: Only 2 probes, against batch 04's 3. The CPU probe is unusual: the chapter's final heading (L563) has an entirely empty body, so the source itself ends on a promised-but-undelivered section.

code_only_scopes.definition: heading scope with prose_lines = 0 AND code_lines > 0
code_only_scopes.note: None. The two shell-heavy scopes (### macOS 설치 L95-L114 with 13 code lines, ### 토픽 생성 및 확인 L115-L165 with 26) each carry prose and are engine-substantive, so the code-only authoring hazard does not arise.

Batch 05 carries 330 prose lines against batch 04's 321, so the prose-line-scaled realized equivalent is 34 x (330/321) = 34.95, and 15% authoring headroom gives ceil(34.95 x 1.15) = 41, floored to a round 40.

B5_forecast_accepted_candidates.escalation_trigger: If authoring exceeds 40 accepted candidates, do NOT raise B5 again. Split the source at scope 10 (### 토픽별 기본값, L327-L481, 119 prose lines) into batch 05b and re-inventory.

why_not_more.note: Both remaining adjacency options were measured, not assumed.
why_not_more.statement: chap02 alone is the MAXIMAL adjacency-preserving selection under the stated budget. The nearest neighbour chap05 breaks both B4 (185%) and B1 (109%); the smallest remaining chapter chap09 still breaks B4 (155%).

selection_rationale.scheduling_hint: The book-batch-04 inventory (.omx/reviews/brain-phase5-book-batch-04-inventory.md §11) scheduled chap02 as batch 05 at 330 prose lines / 92% of B4. This lane independently re-measured that figure from source bytes and reproduces it exactly.
selection_rationale.primary: kafka/chap02.md (카프카 설치하기) is the direct successor to the applied chap01 and the only chapter that supplies the OPERATIONAL layer the applied concepts presuppose: ZooKeeper as the metadata store, the broker configuration parameters, partition-count sizing, retention configuration and hardware provisioning. Every one of its concepts attaches to a vocabulary batch 04 already applied.
selection_rationale.bounded: One extraction file, 29652 bytes, 17 heading scopes of which 15 carry prose and 15 are engine-substantive, 330 prose lines. 49% of the byte ceiling and 92% of the prose-line ceiling - the binding constraint.
selection_rationale.adjacency: A single file trivially preserves per-file adjacency, and chap02 directly follows the applied chap01 with no gap. chap03 and chap04 are frontmatter-only and already discharged as probes, so chap05 is the next unmined chapter and the designated batch 06.
selection_rationale.probes: No file-level probes (discharged by the applied batch 01); 2 in-source zero-evidence scopes provide negative coverage.
rejected_alternatives: chap02 + chap05 (the nearest adjacency pair): 65,606 bytes / 667 prose lines = 185% of B4 and 109% of B1. Rejected on two ceilings.
chap02 + chap09 (the smallest remaining chapter): 56,642 bytes / 558 prose lines = 155% of B4. Rejected on the binding ceiling.

Splitting chap02 into two batches now: rejected because chap02 fits every ceiling whole, and splitting would strand the cross-references between §브로커 설정 and §토픽별 기본값 (e.g. min.insync.replicas at L441-L460 is required to read default.replication.factor at L344-L356). Recorded as the contingency if authoring exceeds B5 = 40.
Skipping to chap09 first (228 prose lines, the smallest remaining): rejected on dependency order - chap09 presupposes the broker configuration vocabulary this chapter defines.

alias_scan_semantics.search_contract_note: Under the repaired exact-alias search contract (.omx/reviews/brain-phase5-book-batch-04-search-repair.md), knowledge_aliases is emitted into contentIndex.json as a non-routing `knowledgeAliases` field and an EXACT alias match (NFC-normalized, trimmed, case-folded) hoists its document to rank 0 ahead of every title and content match. At most one document can claim a given exact key, so any new batch-05 alias that duplicates an applied title or alias would either fail collisionReport() or silently steal an applied concept's rank-0 identity. The scan below therefore covers all three key spaces: applied concept titles, applied knowledge_aliases, and Quartz routing aliases.

Batch 05 contains no technology-agnostic messaging evidence, so no messaging.* concept is expected.

zookeeper_root_decision.question: ZooKeeper is neither Kafka-specific nor a messaging pattern, so the batch-04 rule does not decide it. Root candidates: kafka.zookeeper.* or a new zookeeper.* root.
zookeeper_root_decision.evidence: This source frames ZooKeeper only as Kafka infrastructure: L8 introduces it as `브로커의 메타 데이터를 저장하기 위해 사용되는 아파치 주키퍼`, and L10-L13 frame it as a Kafka-version-dependent dependency being replaced by KRaft. There is no technology-agnostic ZooKeeper claim anywhere in the file, so a standalone zookeeper.* root would be minted on evidence this source does not carry.
zookeeper_root_decision.decision_class: bounded naming decision taken under the owner's standing blanket approval. It follows rule 4 of the batch-04 namespace decision (extraction to a technology-agnostic root is permitted during consolidation; extraction adds concepts and never moves them), so choosing kafka.zookeeper.* now forecloses nothing.

id_rules.N0: concept_id = kafka.<area>.<slug>, area per the H2 rule above.
id_rules.N1: For a configuration parameter, slug = the parameter name exactly as the source writes it, lowercased, with '.' replaced by '-'. Example: `num.recovery.threads.per.data.dir` -> `num-recovery-threads-per-data-dir`.
id_rules.N2: For a non-parameter concept, slug = kebab-case of the established English term for the concept, preferring a term the applied index already uses.
id_rules.N3: document path = content/brain/knowledge/kafka/<area>/<leaf>.md where leaf = slug, EXCEPT when slug equals area, in which case leaf = `kafka-<slug>`. collisionReport() adds a folder_route collision when a filename stem equals its parent folder name; the applied precedent is kafka.broker.broker -> kafka/broker/kafka-broker.md.

preconditions.statement: Scope density is the highest in the series: 22.0 prose lines per positive-prose scope against batch 04's 12.8, with 3 scopes holding 69% of the chapter's prose (119 / 75 / 34 lines).

preconditions.statement: The chapter's prose is not confined to heading scopes. The pre-heading preamble L7-L16 carries 6 citable prose lines including the only KRaft claim in the file, and 11 shell comments inside fenced blocks match the ATX-heading regex.
preconditions.consequence: A parser that ignores the preamble loses citable evidence; a parser that treats fenced shell comments as headings overcounts scopes by 65% (28 vs 17) and would mint concepts from code comments.
preconditions.resolution: Cite the preamble by its literal span L7-L16 (it has no heading_chain); confirm the 17 + 11 = 28 heading accounting before trusting any scope count.

preconditions.statement: B5 was raised from 38 to 40 under the owner's standing blanket approval for bounded budget decisions.

preconditions.statement: The tree-digest recipe is locale-dependent. The content/brain baseline reproduces only under localeCompare row ordering, not byte ordering; see hash_lock.tree_manifest_recipe. The knowledge and books baselines reproduce under both because their paths are ASCII.
preconditions.consequence: localeCompare depends on the ICU build, so the content/brain baseline is not portably reproducible. An independent verifier using `LC_ALL=C sort` will reproduce two of the three baselines and fail the third - a recipe artifact, not drift.
preconditions.resolution: Use the recipe recorded in hash_lock.tree_manifest_recipe. Migrating the tree manifest to byte ordering would change the published content/brain digest and therefore needs an OWNER decision; it was deliberately NOT done in this lane.
